sentences.text: Runni Water Energy Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-10 under the industry code 28250, manufacture of non-domestic air conditioning equipment.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-09-21.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has water and energy words, but the registered industry is air conditioning equipment and the record shows no ocean use.
